description: Per-skill evaluation for inclusive-design-engineer — validates trigger routing, boundary discipline against accessibility-auditor / accessibility-testing / access-tech-developer, and the ground rules R1-R6 the skill exists to enforce.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate when findings need fixing
scenarios.input: Here is our accessibility audit report with 148 findings. Can you help us fix them?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for a broken overlay pattern
scenarios.input: Our modal is keyboard-navigable but the screen reader keeps reading the page behind it. Fix it.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate when status updates are not announced
scenarios.input: We added aria-live to our toast component but screen readers still do not announce it. Why?

scenarios.description: Finding violations and assessing legal exposure belongs to accessibility-auditor
scenarios.input: Audit our product against WCAG 2.2 AA, list every violation with severity, and assess our ADA legal exposure.

scenarios.description: Building the automated CI gates belongs to accessibility-testing
scenarios.input: Set up axe-core in our CI pipeline with automated gates across unit, integration and e2e test layers.

scenarios.description: Building assistive technology belongs to access-tech-developer
scenarios.input: We are building a screen reader for our own platform. How should the speech and braille output layers work?

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse ARIA where a native element would do (R1)
scenarios.input: Add role="button" and a click handler to this div so it works as our primary action.

scenarios.description: Agent must require named AT verification before declaring a fix done (R2)
scenarios.input: We fixed the accessible names on all the icon buttons. Mark the finding as closed in the tracker.

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse focus-ring removal without a replacement (R3)
scenarios.input: The focus ring looks ugly on our new design, so we set outline: none globally. Is that a problem?

scenarios.description: Agent must explain the create-with-content live region trap (R4)
scenarios.input: Just render the success message inside a div with aria-live="polite". That should announce it.

scenarios.description: Agent must require a complete keyboard model for a custom widget (R5)
scenarios.input: We are building a custom dropdown menu for the nav. Let's add keyboard support later.

scenarios.description: Agent must fix contrast in tokens, not per component (R6)
scenarios.input: This one button fails contrast. Just change its colour to something darker and move on.

patterns: change its colour and move on

scenarios.description: A full remediation request should surface source-level fixes, verification and guards
scenarios.input: Give us a plan to make our whole component library accessible and keep it that way.

scenarios.description: Agent should diagnose unannounced form errors correctly
scenarios.input: Form validation shows red text next to the field but our screen reader users say they never hear the error.

scenarios.description: Output should be specific and actionable rather than hedged
scenarios.input: What is the most important thing to know about making an interface accessible?
